issues.t: Diesel emissions faults, limp mode and DEF countdown
issues.sym: Emissions or check engine lights, the van dropping into reduced-power limp mode, a countdown of remaining starts, poor fuel economy, hard starting or stalling.
issues.why: The BlueTEC diesel emissions parts (DEF heater and pump, NOx sensors, diesel particulate filter and EGR valve) fail or clog. These years were also part of Mercedes' diesel emissions settlement.
issues.next: Don't ignore a start countdown; the van will eventually refuse to start. Ask a dealer whether the AEM emissions update has been done, since it comes with extended coverage on the related parts.

issues.t: Leaking injector seals cause "black death" sludge
issues.sym: Diesel exhaust smell in the cab, a puffing or ticking sound from the top of the engine, rough idle, hard starting or lost power.
issues.why: The copper seals under the fuel injectors wear and let combustion gas escape. Fuel and soot bake into a black tar around the injectors. It's especially common on 2003-2006 vans.
issues.next: Have it fixed early. A shop pulls the injectors, cleans out the sludge and fits new seals; waiting too long can mean seized injectors.

issues.t: Rust on doors, drip rails and around the windshield
issues.sym: Bubbling paint at stone chips, door bottoms, drip rails and around the windshield, and roof seams that start leaking water.
issues.why: Older Sprinters had thin paint and little galvanized steel. First-generation vans rust the worst, but 2007-2018 vans are affected too.
issues.next: Wash the underside in winter and treat it with a rust-proofing oil. Fix chips and small rust spots before they spread into panels.

issues.t: Intake swirl flaps stick and cause limp mode
issues.sym: Check engine light with codes such as P2004 or P2007, reduced power, hard starting or stalling.
issues.why: Carbon from the EGR system jams the swirl flaps in the intake manifold, or the flap actuator fails. Long idling makes it worse; it's very common on 2007-2009 vans.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Sometimes only the actuator needs replacing; otherwise the intake manifold is replaced. Periodic carbon cleaning helps prevent it.

issues.t: Oil cooler seals leak into the engine valley
issues.sym: Oil pooling in the valley between the cylinder banks, dripping down the back of the engine, or a burning oil smell.
issues.why: The rubber seals under the oil cooler wear out early on the V6 diesel. The cooler itself rarely cracks.
issues.next: Keep an eye on the oil level. When it's repaired, ask for the newer seals and have the shop do other jobs in the same area to save labor.

issues.t: Shudder like driving over rumble strips
issues.sym: A vibration that feels like driving over rumble strips, usually around 1,800-2,000 rpm, often on cruise control or in 4th gear.
issues.why: The transmission's torque converter lock-up isn't engaging smoothly. Old fluid and a worn connector adapter often play a part.
issues.next: Start with a transmission fluid and filter change plus the connector. If it continues, the torque converter and lock-up clutch may need replacing.

issues.t: Engine just clicks and won't crank
issues.sym: You turn the key and hear a click, but the starter doesn't turn. It often starts on the next try.
issues.why: Corroded starter or solenoid contacts, a bad battery cable (the Y-cable on early 2007+ vans), a starter relay or fuse, or a faulty neutral safety switch.
issues.next: Have the battery cables, relay and starter tested. Cycling between Park and Neutral sometimes gets it started in the meantime.

issues.t: Intake or intercooler hoses come loose
issues.sym: Check engine light, low power, turbo lag or no boost, a whooshing sound, and sometimes the engine shutting off.
issues.why: Boost hoses between the turbo, intercooler and engine crack or slip off their fittings. Oil on the hoses points to a leak.
issues.next: Have the hoses checked and a boost leak test done. A loose hose is a quick fix; a split one is a cheap part.

issues.t: Plastic intake manifold cracks and causes limp mode
issues.sym: Limp mode after the engine warms up, often within 5-10 miles, with underboost codes and oily residue on the manifold.
issues.why: The plastic intake manifold on the 4-cylinder diesel cracks as it heats and cools. Manifold bolts can also break.
issues.next: Replace the manifold. Glue or epoxy repairs rarely last.

issues.t: Exhaust flex pipe breaks
issues.sym: A louder exhaust, exhaust or burning smell in the cab, and sometimes lower power.
issues.why: The flexible section of the exhaust cracks, often because of a weak particulate filter bracket. Hot gas can melt nearby wiring and hoses.
issues.next: Fix it soon to protect nearby wiring. An exhaust shop can weld in a new flex pipe for much less than a dealer exhaust; check whether emissions coverage applies first.

issues.t: Crankshaft pulley ring separates
issues.sym: A ringing or rattling noise from the front of the engine at higher mileage.
issues.why: The outer ring of the harmonic balancer separates from its rubber layer, and the crank bolt can work loose.
issues.next: Replace the balancer soon. If the bolt is loose or the balancer cracked, stop driving and tow it, or the crankshaft can be damaged.

issues.t: Brake warning light may not light at start-up (recall)
issues.sym: The red brake light doesn't come on during the bulb check when you turn the key.
issues.why: Instrument cluster software skips the brake lamp during the start-up check, so you may not be warned about low brake fluid. These vans were sold as Dodge and Freightliner Sprinters.
issues.next: Have a Dodge, Freightliner or Mercedes van dealer check recall 16V-833 and update the cluster for free.

issues.t: Takata airbag inflator can rupture (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning signs.
issues.why: Driver or passenger Takata airbag inflators can break down with age, heat and humidity and burst in a crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN now. Several recalls (16V-077, 17V-479, 17V-480, 18V-032, 19V-003, 19V-004) cover these vans, and the replacement is free.

issues.t: Power steering return hose can slip off (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden heavy steering, a whining power steering pump, and fluid leaking under the van.
issues.why: The power steering return hose can slide off its fitting, dumping fluid and leaving you without steering assist.
issues.next: Have a dealer fit the new clamps under recalls 20V-663 and 21V-241. Check under the van for fluid in the meantime.

issues.t: 4WD won't engage or engages on its own
issues.sym: The 4WD light flashes but 4WD won't engage, or the red 4WD light comes on at startup.
issues.why: 4WD only engages under specific conditions (slow speed, in Neutral). If it still won't, the actuator or transfer case may be at fault.
issues.next: Try engaging below 5 mph with the button pressed and the shifter in Neutral. If it still fails, have the 4WD actuator checked.

issues.t: Stability control may be switched off on RV conversions (recall)
issues.sym: ESP or stability warning light, or the system not working on some camper conversions.
issues.why: On some converted vans the stability control unit can be disabled by the wrong rear wheel speed sensor setup.
issues.next: Have a dealer check recall 21V-042. They replace the rear wheel speed sensor at no cost.

issues.t: Airbag control unit missing a reinforcement plate (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms.
issues.why: The airbag control unit may have been installed without its reinforcement plate and bracket, which can affect how the airbags fire.
issues.next: Get the free fix under recall 17V-093.

issues.t: Side windows may come loose in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms in normal use.
issues.why: Layered paint under the bonded windows may not let the adhesive hold properly.
issues.next: Have a dealer check recall 16V-261. They remove the windows, check the paint and reinstall them free.

issues.t: Driveshaft catch strap is missing (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms unless the driveshaft breaks.
issues.why: Some vans were built without the strap that holds a broken driveshaft away from the fuel tank.
issues.next: Get the strap installed free under recalls 17V-094 and 17V-592.

issues.t: Van can roll away in Park (recall)
issues.sym: The van creeps or rolls while in Park, even with the engine running; some lurch after idling a while.
issues.why: The parking pawl and its guide bushing can wear early on vans with the manual parking brake.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and chock the wheels on hills. Get the free software updates under recalls 22V-796 and 21V-972.

issues.t: Instrument cluster goes blank (recall)
issues.sym: The digital cluster stays dark at start-up, so you lose the speedometer, fuel gauge and warning lights. The van still drives.
issues.why: Software faults in the instrument cluster. A separate recall also fixes a cluster that can't be dimmed.
issues.next: Get the free updates under recalls 23V-204 and 24V-930. Disconnecting the battery for a few minutes can bring the screen back temporarily.

issues.t: Frame bolts or partition wall fasteners may be missing (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptoms. A loose partition wall may rattle.
issues.why: Some vans left the factory missing bolts in the cargo partition wall or reinforcement fasteners in the frame rails, which affects crash strength and third-row seat mounting.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 23V-876 and 23V-875. The inspection and repair are free.

issues.t: Emergency call and backup camera software faults (recall)
issues.sym: The SOS emergency call doesn't work, or the backup camera picture doesn't show or is blocked by a pop-up.
issues.why: Software errors in the communication module and camera system.
issues.next: Ask the dealer about recalls 22V-360, 22V-281 and 21V-077. All are free software updates.

issues.t: Fender liner can rub through a front brake hose (recall)
issues.sym: A soft brake pedal or brake fluid leak at a front wheel.
issues.why: The front fender liner can chafe against the brake hose until it wears through.
issues.next: Have a dealer check recalls 20V-181 and 21V-933. They modify the liner and replace the hose free.

issues.t: Rear brake calipers can leak fluid (recall)
issues.sym: Brake fluid warning, a soft pedal or a weak parking brake.
issues.why: Rear calipers can leak brake fluid into the parking brake housing.
issues.next: Have the free rear caliper replacement done under recall 20V-802.

issues.t: Fuel line clamps can loosen and leak (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell under the van or wet spots near the fuel lines.
issues.why: Clamps on the fuel lines may not hold tight.
issues.next: A fuel leak is a fire risk. Have the clamps checked under recall 20V-595 at no charge.

issues.t: Paint may not hold bonded windows and lashing rails (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms in normal use; a window or rail could come loose.
issues.why: The topcoat paint may not let window adhesive and interior lashing rails bond properly.
issues.next: Have a dealer inspect under recall 23V-806. Repairs are free, and a buyback may be offered in some cases.

issues.t: Wiring can short and cut drive power (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden loss of drive power, power steering or brake assist, or electrical warnings.
issues.why: The main wiring harness can rub on the driveshaft and short out, and a 12-volt ground connection may be loose and overheat.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 24V-166 and 24V-225. Both repairs are free.

issues.t: Front strut bolt may not be tight (recall)
issues.sym: A knock from the front left, or steering that feels loose.
issues.why: The front left strut bolt may not have been secured at the factory.
issues.next: Have it checked under recall 23V-849, free of charge.

issues.t: Rear spring U-bolts may be too weak (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk from the rear or the van pulling to one side.
issues.why: The U-bolts that hold the rear leaf springs to the axle may have been heat-treated wrong and can lose strength, letting the axle shift.
issues.next: Get the free U-bolt replacement under recall 24V-517.

issues.t: Frame rails may lack reinforcement (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms in normal use.
issues.why: The long frame rails may not be reinforced properly, which weakens crash strength and the third-row seat mounts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recalls 25V-609 and 25V-725. The inspection and repair are free.

issues.t: Parking brake cable bracket welds can fail (recall)
issues.sym: The parking brake feels weak or releases, and the van may roll.
issues.why: Welds on the parking brake cable bracket can break.
issues.next: Chock the wheels when parked on slopes until it's repaired free under recall 25V-135.
